notes: Cover chamfer revision: 0.2 mm inner perimeter, pocket-mouth rim, and inner screw-entry chamfers; 0.2 mm USB entry chamfers on both sides. Pocket top raised to 10.25 mm to keep the inner USB rim continuous.
Two changed cover STL files were re-sliced; six earlier records were reused only after exact SHA-256 verification. Per-file recheck timestamps distinguish fresh slices.

No floating, unsupported-region, repair, or plate-level geometry warnings were reported by the successful slices. The USB cover coupon still emits one nonfatal ZFiller error-level diagnostic; its fresh extrusion check covers 12 layers and 12 connected components with none entirely absent.
Routine CLI diagnostics are counted for this recheck only. They concern CLI mode, missing model colour, and the default tree-support style; effective support settings remained disabled.

Flat-floor revision: uniform 2.0 mm base floor; tray and USB opening lowered together by 0.8 mm from the preceding revision. Inward cover ribs removed. Rear tray keys moved forward to engage inside the base.
The user-measured 1.2 mm USB vertical seating correction and 1.0 mm base depth reduction remain applied. Confirm revised dimensions on the actual print.

Summed quantity-weighted times model each physical piece printed separately, including repeated startup and purge overhead. The second-eye estimate reuses its identical single-copy slice. Grouping parts on a plate changes the estimate.
The separate USB fit-test set is 06_PCB_tray_black + 01_USB_base_coupon + 02_USB_cover_coupon; the tray is also used in the final assembly.
PCB retention uses a captured sliding tray with two side clips and 45-degree hook/front-lip ramps; no cable ties. Confirm physical clip action and hardware fit.

The mascot has two integral straight pins with 45-degree rear haunches. User tested the 3.3 mm hand socket coupon: locating fit without friction retention; glue can secure the permanent assembly. Pins and hand coupons are unchanged. Simultaneous two-pin assembly remains unverified.
User coupon tests selected 1.9 mm screw pilots and 5.1 mm LED bores; cover/retainer screw heads seated flush. Full assembly fit remains unverified.
No G-code is included in the deliverables. Keep the plate and settings used for successful physical coupons; Bambu filament brand and the textured validation plate are explicit assumptions.

integral_hand_joint.physical_test_result: Single-pin coupon fits for positioning, not friction retention; optional glue for permanent assembly.

slicer_diagnostic_review.result: All diagnostic-bearing meshes have successful slices and component-presence checks for their current SHA-256. Diagnostics remain disclosed; they are not classified as proven harmless.
slicer_diagnostic_review.toolpath_check_method: Read actual positive-E model G1 paths and sampled G2/G3 arcs; rasterize each STL layer midpoint at 0.1 mm, check every connected component >=0.08 mm2 receives extrusion within 0.3 mm. Checks entire absent components and missing whole layers only; does not prove complete local coverage or physical strength. Coordinates use slicer XY arrangement translation with orientation disabled.

source_review.finding: The version-matched source logs the clip-index condition in detect_floating_line, then continues into merge_lines. This establishes continuation, not correctness of every local toolpath.

slicer_diagnostic_review.limitation: The component-presence check can detect whole missing regions, but does not prove complete local extrusion coverage, dimensional accuracy, or physical print strength. Inspect the USB cover coupon slice in the user slicer before printing.
